when.test: queue == 'SHIP' or queue == 'SHIP_TODAY' or queue == 'SHIP_OVERDUE' or queue == 'SHIP_ALL'

choose.otherwise:
SELECT ro.source_type, a.rental_order_id order_id, ro.channel_order_id, ro.order_no, d.id device_id, a.id assignment_id, d.device_no, d.equipment_model_code, NULL goods_title, ro.preparation_status, ro.preparation_reason_code, NULL required_quantity, FALSE quantity_needs_review, DATE_SUB(ro.occupy_end_date_exclusive, INTERVAL 1 DAY) due_date FROM rental_device_assignment a JOIN rental_device d ON d.id=a.device_id AND d.tenant_id=a.tenant_id AND d.deleted=0 JOIN rental_order ro ON ro.id=a.rental_order_id AND ro.tenant_id=a.tenant_id AND ro.deleted=0 WHERE a.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND a.deleted=0
AND a.status IN ('DISPATCHED','DISPATCHED_PENDING_PLAN') AND a.returned_at IS NOT NULL AND a.inspection_completed_at IS NULL
AND d.status='MAINTENANCE' AND a.status='RETURNED' AND a.inspection_result='FAILED' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM rental_device_assignment newer WHERE newer.tenant_id=a.tenant_id AND newer.device_id=a.device_id AND newer.deleted=0 AND newer.id>a.id AND newer.status IN ('DISPATCHED','DISPATCHED_PENDING_PLAN','RETURNED'))
AND a.status IN ('DISPATCHED','DISPATCHED_PENDING_PLAN') AND a.returned_at IS NULL
AND ro.occupy_end_date_exclusive=DATE_ADD(#{today}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND ro.occupy_end_date_exclusive <= #{today}

mapper.select: SELECT * FROM () t ORDER BY due_date ASC, order_id ASC, channel_order_id ASC, device_id ASC LIMIT #{offset},#{limit}
